en: Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, there arises a state associated with painful feeling by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling...

Dependent on a state associated with neither-pleasant-nor-unpleasant feeling, states associated with neither-pleasant-nor-unpleasant feeling and associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling, states that are associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and not associated with painful feeling arise by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state not associated with pleasant feeling,
states that are associated with neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling and not associated with painful feeling arise.
